common_intent_requirements.text: 把一个小球从手中静止松开
common_intent_requirements.normal_source_quote: 把一个小球从手中静止松开
common_intent_requirements.h3_refined_evidence: one hand holding a small ball motionless above an unobstructed floor. The camera holds a static shot with both the release point and the floor visible. After a brief still hold, the fingers open and withdraw without throwing or pushing the ball.
falls downward along one continuous path until it reaches the floor.

common_intent_requirements.text: 画面里看清松手和下落过程
common_intent_requirements.normal_source_quote: 画面里看清松手和下落过程
common_intent_requirements.h3_refined_evidence: Keep the opening fingers, the ball in flight, and its arrival at the floor readable within the frame.

physics_checks.criterion: 静止释放且失去支撑后，小球整体向地面下落，并与地面发生可解释的接触。
physics_checks.observable_evidence: 能辨认手指释放、小球离手和到达地面的先后关系。
fail_examples: 球离手后无外力持续悬停或向上飞走
球在空中直接消失并在地面重新出现
球未接触地面就停在半空
not_required: 不测重力加速度或逐帧位移
不规定触地后的弹跳次数或高度

evaluation_boundary: Assess only supplied requirements. Professional additions are not hidden requirements for ordinary input.
